user.title: Charge point
user.description: Select the sensor measuring the EV charger power. A cumulative energy meter is optional but more accurate.

data_description.power_entity: Sensor in W or kW used to detect charging.
data_description.energy_entity: Cumulative kWh sensor; preferred over integrating the power.

data_description.threshold_w: Charging when power is above this value.
data_description.start_delay_s: Power must stay above the threshold this long to start a session.
data_description.stop_delay_s: Power must stay below the threshold this long to end a session.

data_description.price_entity: Entity giving the kWh price (€/kWh, c€/kWh or €/MWh). Price changes during a session are taken into account.

abort.already_configured: This power sensor is already tracked.
